xd_02.question: Is azoxystrobin used against only a single disease among the three studied?
xd_02.kg: No, according to the facts, azoxystrobin is authorised against more than one disease (late blight and apple scab).
xd_02.rag:
No, azoxystrobin is used against multiple diseases:

- Late blight (Phytophthora infestans) on potato
- Cucurbit powdery mildew (Podosphaera xanthii) on cucurbit.
